title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval of a 365 day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Northeastren University.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore Grants the Company's rquest for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participatin in the decision were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 01-18)
